result.summary: Several visual layout and clipping issues: restaurant names and cards are cut off, category chips overflow, and the bottom nav is partially obscured.

issues.description: Restaurant cards in 'Fastest near you' are clipped on the right; the third card (Trattoria Piccol...) and its name are cut off mid-text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll or grid allows full card visibility, or add proper truncation with ellipsis and peek of next card without cutting mid-word.

issues.description: Category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) overflow the screen edge with a partial chip visible on the right.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scrolling for the chip row or wrap/resize so all chips are fully visible or clearly scrollable.

issues.description: Bottom tab bar icons and labels are partially cut off at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area insets and ensure the tab bar sits fully above the home indicator / screen edge.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated without clear ellipsis treatment.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent text overflow (ellipsis) and ensure names remain readable.

issues.description: Promo banner and section cards use heavy rounded corners while clipped content makes the layout feel unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Align card widths/padding so content isn’t cropped against rounded containers.
